questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: look at place, days of the week, timetable and examination date and the type of work you have to make. I can be hard to make one assignment every week in all of your courses. You also need time to be in a new country, meet new people and how to study in a different university
